items.html: And when the seven kings ascended in the three phases, to be corrected in the secret of pregnancy within AVI, as above, the Hesed, the Netzah, half the Tifferet, half the Yesod, and the right half of the Malchut were found standing inside Aba, and their other half inside Ima. And on the first day of the absorption, those halves that were inside Aba joined together and became units: Hesed was included in Netzah, Yesod in Tifferet, and Malchut in Yesod, and they were tied in the phase of lines, one in the other, and they grasped together. And afterwards, on the second day of the absorption, the halves inside Ima grasped and were tied together, one in the other, in the phase of lines. And afterwards, on the third day, those inside Aba were tied together with those inside Ima, and then Aba gave Ima the half that was in him. Thus all of ZA is found given inside Ima by the end of the three days of absorption. However, all this is in the phase of the vessels.
